title: Indicator moment norm
statement: Let $A\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$ and let $r\in\mathbb R$ with $r>0$. Under the uniform probability measure on the Boolean cube, the $r$-moment norm of its indicator is $\bigl(\mathbb E|\mathbf1_A|^r\bigr)^{1/r}=\mu(A)^{1/r}$.
replaced: For every $A\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$ and $r>0$, its moment norm under the uniform cube law satisfies $\|\mathbf1_A\|_r=(|A|/2^n)^{1/r}$.
